results.content: A written denial is not the same as an informal disagreement with an adjuster. The appeal process begins with the denial letter, and the letter controls the deadline. If the 60th day falls on a weekend or federal holiday, the deadline extends to the next business day. The NFIP appeal rules from FloodSmart explain this calculation.
